fixes.explanation: You've got it. Jesus says, “Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.” Son of Man is the name Jesus uses for Himself (Mark 2:10). Even a fox gets a den, and the One who made the foxes has no place to lay His head. The man said he'd follow wherever Jesus goes, and this is what that road looks like.
